name: crisp
note: Short, tight interface ticks and clicks for energetic dev-tool and product films. Quick air carries movement, one clean gated hit lands the reveal, and a brief sub drop sits in tune.

tick.note: Dominoes knocking (CC0 fit). Until the CC0 fit file ships, the forge member tap/glass stands in for fit/tick/domino; the level keeps the role's loudness.

tick.crisp.note: A bright designed tink, 37 ms, one attack. Keep it low.

hit.note: One clean gated hit, 0.67 s: one attack and no lead-in (10 ms pre-swell).

land.note: A low, round thump for heavier elements.

land.light.note: Fingers on a book (CC0 fit, 0.38 s). Until the CC0 fit file ships, the forge member pro_tap/finger stands in for fit/land.light/fingertip_book; the level keeps the role's loudness.

pop.note: A round pop-in thump with no glide, so a run of pops does not turn 8-bit.

whoosh.short.note: A short, quick pass (0.54 s, peak at 0.16 s) for whip pans and fly-ins.

whoosh.long.note: A full swell of air for scene changes.

drop.note: The shortest designed sub drop, 1.0 s, growing 110 ms after the cut. Set edits.pitch to the root (G1 to C2).

key.note: One mechanical key, down and up (CC0 fit, 0.43 s, centroid 2.2 kHz), a new take per keystroke. Until the CC0 fit file ships, the forge member typing_key/crisp stands in for fit/key/medium; the level keeps the role's loudness.

key.space.note: A mechanical space bar (CC0 fit). Until the CC0 fit file ships, the forge member typing_key/thock stands in for fit/key.space/thock_space; the level keeps the role's loudness.

key.return.note: A clicky switch for Return, brighter and harder than the run.

click.note: A small plastic click (CC0 fit). Until the CC0 fit file ships, the forge member tap/finger stands in for fit/click/floss_lid; the level keeps the role's loudness.

snap.note: A switch flip (CC0 fit). Until the CC0 fit file ships, the forge member toggle/latch stands in for fit/snap/switch_flip; the level keeps the role's loudness.

bell.note: Tuned kalimba over 2 octaves of C pentatonic.

text.note: A finger on a phone (CC0 fit, 0.33 s, centroid 95 Hz). It is untuned, so it cannot clash with the music, and sits 7 dB up because it is quieter at the same peak. Until the CC0 fit file ships, the forge member pro_tap/soft stands in for fit/land.light/finger_phone; the level keeps the role's loudness.

off.suck: a suck builds on top of the reveal
off.riser: off; pro_riser/air_gate is the short choice when a build is needed, never an endless riser
off.swell: a swell puts a lead-in on top of the hit
